title: Health Charted Research Index
description: Index of deep research files with entity coverage for cross-referencing and gap detection.

filename.description: Alias for file. Either may be used; both are accepted.

research_id.description: Stable identifier for the research file (e.g., RE-2026-0504-001). Issued by the research engine on creation.

when_to_reference.description: When this file is useful during a session

depth.description: Research depth tier (1 = light, 3 = deep). Recorded for retrospective evaluation of evidence weight.

date_created.description: ISO date the research file was generated

source_count.description: Number of sources cited in the research file

filename_date_note.description: Free-text note when the filename's embedded date differs from date_created (e.g., back-dated synthesis of older sources)

entities.description: Canonical entity names covered by this file, keyed by entity type. Used for cross-referencing, propagation, and gap detection.
